title: Slovakian Pasta Bake
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired pasta dish with a crispy, cheesy top. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: unique
ingredients.notes: unique squash variety, peeled and chopped

instructions: Cook the rigatoni according to package instructions until al dente, then set aside.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the chopped unique, snappy, and slovakian. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5-7 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked rigatoni, vegetable mixture, and 1 cup of the grated pasta.
In a separate bowl, mix together 1 cup of the grated pasta, 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese, and 1/4 cup of chopped fresh parsley.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with the cheese mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the pasta is heated through.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
